message:
1 helper(s) taken from the suite's own modules by a name no definition in the corpus carries:
      rim.spec.ts:2 — `* as css`, imported from `./support/css`
    Every
why: The hovered card's race, read through `css.styleOf` of `import * as css`. To the scanner a call through a namespace is a method of an object and not a helper by name, so point 3 walks past the race. The namespace is refused whole rather than per call: no call through one is ever the bare name a vocabulary holds.
